answer: Randomized Shard Assignment Gate: each round, a verifiable randomness beacon (VRF over prior block hash) assigns every agent to a shale-like shard of fixed capacity, and only shard members may transact that round. An attacker cannot precompute placements, so identities must be created in bulk before each round to guarantee presence; each identity costs a saffron-denominated registration plus ongoing proof-of-work to stay live. Marginal sybil cost scales linearly per shard island, since surplus identities that miss assignment are wasted spend.
